# COLT config file (generated by colt_projection.py)
--- !projections
init_file: ics/snapshot.hdf5
output_dir: output
output_base: proj
save_connections: false
avoid_edges: false
field_weight_pairs: [[rho, avg]]
override_volume: true
adaptive: false
camera: [0, 0, 1]
camera_north: [0, 1, 0]
camera_center: [1.0016124857830413e+24, 1.0016124857830413e+24, 1.0016124857830413e+24]
image_radius: 1.1571290930501969e+23
n_pixels: 256
proj_depth: 2.0032249715660826e+24
settings.peak_rss_source: getrusage(RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss (max over all children so far)

colt.defines:
# Compile-time definitions for the vortrace comparison build
GEOMETRY: voronoi   # Unstructured Voronoi mesh (Arepo)
HAVE_CGAL: true     # Construct the mesh from generator positions with CGAL
NO_MPI: true        # Single rank, OpenMP threads only
long_neighbors: true  # neighbors_tot ~ 16 N: int32 would overflow near 1.3e8 cells; cheap insurance

settings.ski_contents:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!-- Exact column density through an Arepo Voronoi mesh;
     written by vortrace/paper/code_comparison/skirt_projection.py -->
<skirt-simulation-hierarchy type="MonteCarloSimulation" format="9"
                            producer="vortrace code_comparison">
  <MonteCarloSimulation userLevel="Expert" simulationMode="ExtinctionOnly"
                        numPackets="0">
    <random type="Random">
      <Random seed="0"/>
    </random>
    <units type="Units">
      <ExtragalacticUnits/>
    </units>
    <cosmology type="Cosmology">
      <LocalUniverseCosmology/>
    </cosmology>
    <sourceSystem type="SourceSystem">
      <SourceSystem minWavelength="0.09 micron" maxWavelength="100 micron"
                    wavelengths="0.55 micron" sourceBias="0.5"/>
    </sourceSystem>
    <mediumSystem type="MediumSystem">
      <MediumSystem>
        <media type="Medium">
          <VoronoiMeshMedium filename="medium.txt"
                             minX="0.0 pc" maxX="649201.0 pc" minY="0.0 pc" maxY="649201.0 pc" minZ="-324600.5 pc" maxZ="324600.5 pc"
                             massType="MassDensity" massFraction="1"
                             importMetallicity="false"
                             importTemperature="false"
                             importVelocity="false"
                             importMagneticField="false"
                             importVariableMixParams="false" useColumns="">
            <materialMix type="MaterialMix">
              <MeanInterstellarDustMix/>
            </materialMix>
          </VoronoiMeshMedium>
        </media>
        <samplingOptions type="SamplingOptions">
          <SamplingOptions numDensitySamples="1" numPropertySamples="1"/>
        </samplingOptions>
        <grid type="SpatialGrid">
          <VoronoiMeshSpatialGrid minX="0.0 pc" maxX="649201.0 pc" minY="0.0 pc" maxY="649201.0 pc" minZ="-324600.5 pc" maxZ="324600.5 pc"
                                  policy="ImportedMesh"/>
        </grid>
      </MediumSystem>
    </mediumSystem>
    <instrumentSystem type="InstrumentSystem">
      <InstrumentSystem/>
    </instrumentSystem>
    <probeSystem type="ProbeSystem">
      <ProbeSystem>
        <probes type="Probe">
          <DensityProbe probeName="coldens" aggregation="Type"
                        probeAfter="Setup">
            <form type="Form">
              <ParallelProjectionForm inclination="0 deg" azimuth="0 deg"
                                      roll="90 deg"
                                      fieldOfViewX="75000.0 pc"
                                      numPixelsX="256"
                                      centerX="324600.5 pc"
                                      fieldOfViewY="75000.0 pc"
                                      numPixelsY="256"
                                      centerY="324600.5 pc"
                                      numSampling="1"/>
            </form>
          </DensityProbe>
        </probes>
      </ProbeSystem>
    </probeSystem>
  </MonteCarloSimulation>
</skirt-simulation-hierarchy>
settings.orientation: inclination 0, azimuth 0, roll 90 deg: image x = model x, image y = model y; FITS [y, x] transposed to [x, y]
